تشابكت (form VI)
# تَشَابَكْتُ (tašābaktu) /ta.ʃaː.bak.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَشَابَكَ (tašābaka)
# تَشَابَكْتَ (tašābakta) /ta.ʃaː.bak.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَشَابَكَ (tašābaka)
# تَشَابَكْتِ (tašābakti) /ta.ʃaː.bak.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَشَابَكَ (tašābaka)
# تَشَابَكَتْ (tašābakat) /ta.ʃaː.ba.kat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
